name: Generic OBD-II (SAE J1979)
vehicles: Any OBD-II / EOBD vehicle with a CAN diagnostic bus
author: OpenTune contributors
description: Standardised, maker-independent OBD-II content: the ISO 15765-4 11-bit module addresses for Auto-scan, a mode-01 live-data logger for the common PIDs, and service scripts for readiness / DTC reads / VIN and the mode-04 clear. Everything here is defined by SAE J1979 / ISO 15031-5 and ISO 15765-4; no manufacturer data.
